description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
